description: A shell script for automounting and unmounting block devices in response to udev events, handling systemd integration, device ignoring, and mount point management.

methods.name: automount_systemd
methods.description: Handles auto-mounting of devices using systemd-mount, with checks for existing mounts and device labels.

methods.name: automount
methods.description: Handles auto-mounting of devices using mount or pmount, with label handling and permissions adjustments.

methods.name: rm_dir
methods.description: Removes a directory if it is empty or only contains the mount point.

methods.name: get_label_name
methods.description: Retrieves the label or partition label of a device to use as part of the mount directory name.
